hook.goal: Create an emotional connection with the ladybug — notice its red coat with black polka dots, tiny legs, and cute appearance
hook.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, experience/preference hook, invitational tone

transition.goal: Invite the child to become a Polka-Dot Patrol Officer and find 3 more things with dots, spots, or circles nearby
transition.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, frame as invitation not command, end with Would you like to...?

rounds.goal: Guide child to find their first spotted or dotted item nearby
rounds.scenario: first collection find — spots or dots
rounds.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, invitational phrasing, suggest looking at flowers or ground

rounds.goal: Guide child to find a second spotted or speckled item
rounds.scenario: second collection find — speckles or spots
rounds.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, invitational phrasing, celebrate previous find

rounds.goal: Guide child to find one more spotted item — the third and last one
rounds.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, invitational phrasing, prompt child to go find it
rounds.escalation_note: peak energy — but child still needs to find this item

celebrate.goal: Celebrate the child as a Polka-Dot Patrol Officer — they noticed Form of spots and found Connection between spotted things; connect to IB concepts Form and Connection
celebrate.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, name 2 IB concepts naturally

closing.goal: Leave the child with a cross-session hook — keep patrol eyes open for spots and dots hiding everywhere
closing.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, warm and encouraging

synthesis.goal: Look at all spotted treasures together — notice how the same pattern (dots/spots) looks different on each item (big dots, tiny speckles, round circles)

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye — great patrol work, the polka dots will be waiting next time
early_exit.constraint: T1 max 3 sentences, no pressure to continue

widget_params.description: Ladybug photo centered with spots gently highlighted
